events.evidence: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer less than two weeks after he resigned following revelations of an affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected by U.S. intelligence
Ukraine launches a large-scale drone attack across western Russia, striking the Perm refinery in Perm Krai and Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov Oblast
The United Kingdom's foreign secretary Ed Miliband announces sanctions against five military leaders of Myanmar, while also granting recognition of the Rohingya genocide

label.note: Geopolitical attacks, sanctions, and Nvidia leadership scandal dominate; limited broad market impact.
